The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and spots covering its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad with visible eyes, and the front left limb is clearly extended, showing digits. The body curves towards the right, with the tail partially visible but blending into the background.
